# yii3-mcp-audit-log-bridge

AI audit trail for MCP servers: records every rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp tools/call
into rasuvaeff/yii3-audit-log.

## Install

```bash
composer require rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp-audit-log-bridge
```

## Rules

- One audit event per tools/call (all registration paths: attribute tools,
  OpenAPI bridge, configurators). Failures are recorded AND rethrown — the
  MCP error envelope is unchanged.
- Arguments are masked by FIELD NAME only (AuditLogger's
  SensitiveValueMasker; not recursive): top-level argument `password` =>
  `***`, a secret nested in an array value is stored as-is.
- Call metadata change-fields are prefixed `mcp.` (`mcp.outcome`,
  `mcp.duration_ms`, `mcp.error`) so they never collide with argument names.

## API reference

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Yii3McpAuditLogBridge\AuditTrailInterceptor;

new AuditTrailInterceptor(
    auditLogger: $auditLogger,    // Rasuvaeff\Yii3AuditLog\AuditLogger (writer+clock+masker)
    actorType: 'mcp-client',      // default
    subjectType: 'mcp-tool',      // default
);
// implements Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\Interceptor\ToolCallInterceptorInterface

// Via config-plugin params of yii3-mcp (DI resolves the FQCN):
// 'rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp' => ['interceptors' => [AuditTrailInterceptor::class]]

// Event mapping:
// actor    = AuditActor(actorType, id: session uuid|null, name: 'client-name version'|null)
// action   = 'mcp.tools.call'
// subject  = AuditSubject(subjectType, id: tool name)
// changes  = each argument as its own field (old=null, new=value)
//            + 'mcp.outcome' ('success'|'error') + 'mcp.duration_ms' (int)
//            + 'mcp.error' (exception message, only on failure)
// metadata = AuditMetadata(requestId: session uuid, userAgent: client name)
```
